HomePage.title: Street Lamp Predictive Maintenance — Predictive Care for Solar Street Lights

PublicFooter.description: An IoT-based predictive maintenance platform for solar-powered public street lights — monitoring every lamp and predicting failures before they happen.
PublicFooter.copyright: Street Lamp Predictive Maintenance. All rights reserved.

HeroSection.description: Monitor every solar street light in real time — battery, solar panel and LED — and let machine learning predict failures so your team can repair before the lights go dark.

ProblemSection.description: Thousands of street lights are spread across the city, yet their condition is only known once they go dark. Maintenance becomes reactive, costly and slow.

late_detection.title: Failures are noticed too late
late_detection.desc: Broken lights are often only reported by residents days later, while the street is already dark and unsafe.

manual_patrol.title: Costly manual patrols
manual_patrol.desc: Crews have to drive around checking each pole — wasting time, fuel and manpower with no guarantee of finding the issue.

battery_degradation.title: Unmonitored battery degradation
battery_degradation.desc: Battery capacity and solar panel efficiency decline silently until the lamp can no longer last the night.

no_data.title: Decisions without data
no_data.desc: Without historical data, maintenance schedules and spare-part procurement are based on guesswork.

reactive.title: The old way (reactive)
reactive.desc: Wait for the lamp to fail

SolutionSection.description: Each lamp streams telemetry through an ESP32. The platform turns it into health status, risk predictions and automatic repair tickets.

sense.title: Sensors read
sense.desc: An ESP32 on every pole measures battery, voltage, power, and ambient light every few minutes.

send.title: Data is sent
send.desc: Telemetry travels over MQTT to the server — and is buffered on the device when the signal drops.

analyze.title: The model scores risk
analyze.desc: Machine learning computes a health score, failure risk, and estimated days until failure.

act.title: The team acts
act.desc: Alerts and repair tickets are created automatically, with priority and an assigned technician.

lamp.title: LED Lamp Head
lamp.desc: High-efficiency LED array with adaptive 10–100% dimming plus light/motion sensors to save energy during quiet hours.

solar.title: Monocrystalline Solar Panel
solar.desc: A 100 Wp panel with 22% conversion efficiency charges the battery by day. Its output is tracked to detect dirty or damaged panels.

battery.title: LiFePO4 Battery + BMS
battery.desc: Long-cycle battery with a Battery Management System. Level, voltage and temperature are reported periodically so degradation can be predicted.

controller.title: ESP32 IoT Controller
controller.desc: The brain of the lamp: reads every sensor, sends telemetry over MQTT/HTTP, receives brightness & schedule commands and supports OTA updates.

CoreFeaturesSection.description: From the sensor on the pole to the report for management — one complete workflow.

realtime.title: Real-time Monitoring
realtime.desc: Voltage, current, power, battery, lux and temperature of every lamp, live on the dashboard.

prediction.title: Failure Prediction (ML)
prediction.desc: Machine learning models estimate failure probability and the number of days until failure.

tickets.title: Repair Tickets
tickets.desc: Tickets are created automatically on faults and assigned to technicians, with notes and photos.

map.title: Lamp Map
map.desc: See every lamp's status on an interactive map and locate problem spots in seconds.

schedule.title: Schedules & Dimming
schedule.desc: Set on-hours, automatic sunrise/sunset and brightness profiles sent straight to the device.

reports.title: Ready-to-download Reports
reports.desc: Status, energy, maintenance and prediction reports in PDF or CSV.

LiveMonitoringSection.description: An aggregated snapshot of every connected lamp, refreshed every 30 seconds.

government.title: Public Works / Local Gov.
government.desc: Track street-light assets, energy budget and maintenance performance in one view.

operator.title: Operators & Technicians
operator.desc: Receive prioritised tickets, log repairs and upload photo evidence.

village.title: Villages & Districts
village.desc: Keep neighbourhood roads lit with energy-independent solar lamps.

FAQSection.description: Can't find your answer? Reach our team via the contact details at the bottom of the page.

what_is.question: What is Street Lamp Predictive Maintenance?
what_is.answer: A platform for monitoring IoT-enabled solar street lights and predicting their failures with machine learning, so maintenance happens before the lights go out.

how_predict.question: How are failures predicted?
how_predict.answer: An ML model learns telemetry patterns (battery, voltage, power, temperature, lux) and outputs a risk level, failure probability and estimated days to failure. Predictions activate after at least 48 telemetry points (~4 days).

hardware.question: What hardware does each lamp need?
hardware.answer: An ESP32 controller connected to voltage/current sensors, the battery BMS and a light sensor. Data is periodically sent to the server over Wi-Fi/MQTT.

offline.question: What happens when a lamp loses connection?
offline.answer: The lamp keeps running on its last schedule. The system marks it offline after a timeout and raises an alert so the team can inspect it.

roles.question: Who can use the platform?
roles.answer: Admins manage users and system settings, operators handle monitoring and repair tickets, and viewers can see dashboards and reports.

data.question: Can data be exported?
data.answer: Yes. Telemetry can be exported to CSV, and status, energy, maintenance and prediction reports are available as PDF and CSV.
